metadata.title: Security National Unity Division Patterns
metadata.description: Patterns for sectarian division, social fracture, and disunity.

concepts.title: National Unity
concepts.description: Social cohesion, public peace, and rejection of division.

concepts.title: Public Order
concepts.description: Order, stability, compliance, and societal calm.

concepts.title: Government
concepts.description: Government authority, ministries, or the governing order.

entries.title: Divisive Speech
entries.description: Speech that encourages division between groups or weakens collective peace.
supporting_evidence: The text asks people to split or turn against each other.
The sentence frames division as useful or desirable.
contradictory_evidence: The story later rejects the division.
The wording is historical or educational.
false_positives: A fictional conflict that ends in reconciliation.
A neutral sociological discussion of division.
counter_examples: A report describing a past dispute.
cross_sentence_indicators: A neutral sentence is followed by a division directive.
reviewer_guidance: Look for language that encourages fracture rather than debate.
Do not classify neutral analysis of social conflict.

glossary_relationships.note: Governance can be implicated when unity is attacked.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when the text fractures cohesion or social peace.
Use when division is used as a means of unrest.
